title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research

summary: As publications and products on time series forecasting (TSF) proliferate, researchers face a growing burden of analyzing existing work. First, not all publications release code.
takeaways: We therefore propose to use AI agents for benchmarking TSF research and even supporting autoresearch, e.g., developing new TSF models.

Yet directly applying existing coding agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, is suboptimal: prohibitive costs, limited scalability to large research projects (e.g., benchmarking), and lack of self-maintenance.
In reproduction and benchmarking, TSFLab improves task completion by 20-163% and cuts fresh tokens per completed task by 11-66% across baselines.
